headline: Lennox International (LII) Is Down 22.4% After Cutting 2026 EPS Guidance Amid Residential Weakness – Has The Bull Case Changed?
summary: Lennox International recently reported its second-quarter 2026 results, showing modest sales growth to US$1,545.3 million but slightly lower net income of US$269 million, while also trimming full-year earnings guidance to US$23.00–US$24.00 per share. Beneath the headline numbers, a 24% revenue increase in the commercial Building Climate Solutions segment contrasted sharply with a 7% residential decline, underlining how shifting demand between non-residential projects and pressured homeowners...
